# qutwo-ai and GDK

> This site covers using qutwo-ai, the open-source agent application, and building applications with the qutwo-ai Development Kit (GDK).

Read the relevant documentation before writing commands, configuration, or code. Guides and Python/Kotlin references below are Markdown; native Rust APIs link to docs.rs.

## Using qutwo-ai

- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md): Run your first session in qutwo-ai Desktop or the CLI.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install qutwo-ai for your platform.
- [Model providers](/docs/getting-started/providers.md): Connect qutwo-ai to a hosted or local model.
- [Configuration files](/docs/guides/config-files.md): Find settings and credential storage locations for your platform and configure providers, models, and extensions.
- [Extensions](/docs/getting-started/using-extensions.md): Add and configure tools through MCP.
- [Permissions](/docs/guides/managing-tools/qutwo-ai-permissions.md): Choose when qutwo-ai may act without approval.
- [CLI reference](/docs/guides/qutwo-ai-cli-commands.md): Look up command names, flags, and examples.
- [Recipes](/docs/guides/recipes/recipe-reference.md): Write reusable workflows; consult the field reference before creating recipe YAML.
- [Sessions](/docs/guides/sessions/session-management.md): Start, resume, and manage conversations.
- [Project instructions](/docs/guides/context-engineering/using-qutwoaihints.md): Supply context through AGENTS.md, .qutwoaihints, or custom filenames.
- [Skills](/docs/guides/context-engineering/using-skills.md): Create and install reusable agent instructions.

## For developers

Use GDK's Rust crates to assemble an agent or call models directly. Python and Kotlin bindings expose providers and conversation compaction, not the full agent runtime. Use ACP to make the pre-built qutwo-ai agent the backend for your application.

- [Introduction](/docs/gdk/index.md): Choose how GDK and qutwo-ai fit your application.
- [Getting Started](/docs/gdk/hello-world.md): Build a small Rust agent with tools, streaming, and a saved conversation.
- [Demos](/docs/gdk/demos/index.md): Find working projects, source code, and explanations of their architectural choices.
- [State machine](/docs/gdk/concepts/state-machine.md): Understand execution order, effects, persistence, yielding, and resuming.
- [Operations](/docs/gdk/concepts/operations.md): Compose behavior, inspect existing implementations, and write your own operation.
- [Providers](/docs/gdk/concepts/providers.md): Choose or implement a model backend, including declarative providers, local inference and voice.
- [Authentication](/docs/gdk/concepts/authentication.md): Supply provider credentials or integrate your own authentication.
- [Build an app with qutwo-ai](/docs/gdk/acp/index.md): Launch qutwo-ai over ACP, connect, send prompts, and handle streamed updates and permissions.
- [qutwo-ai ACP extensions](/docs/gdk/acp/reference.md): Look up qutwo-ai-specific protocol methods, notifications, and types; use the linked ACP specification for standard methods.
- [Reference](/docs/gdk/reference/index.md): Choose crates and follow links to generated Rust, Python, and Kotlin API documentation. Check the API version against your dependencies before writing code.

### Generated Rust APIs

Use the docs.rs version selector to match your dependencies; `latest` may differ from the version you installed.

- [StateMachine](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-agent/latest/qutwo_ai_agent/machine/struct.StateMachine.html): Assemble and run steps, or drive stepping and effect application yourself.
- [Operation](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-agent/latest/qutwo_ai_agent/operation/trait.Operation.html): Implement custom behavior and inference contributions.
- [Tools](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-agent/latest/qutwo_ai_agent/tool/index.html): Define and execute typed tools.
- [Provider contract](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-provider-types/latest/qutwo_ai_provider_types/base/trait.Provider.html): Implement streaming model calls and inspect capabilities.
- [Provider implementations](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-providers/latest/qutwo_ai_providers/): Construct backends and configure HTTP authentication.
- [Compaction](https://docs.rs/qutwo-ai-context-management/latest/qutwo_ai_context_management/): Summarize conversations through your own storage interfaces.

### Generated Python and Kotlin APIs

These references require no JavaScript. Each identifies the exact API snapshot and links to a versioned copy.

- [Python API](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md): Provider constructors, records, enums, callbacks, and errors. Start at [functions](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md#functions) to construct a provider.
- Python calls: [completion](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md#provider-complete), [streaming](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md#provider-stream), [stream chunks](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md#providerstream-next-chunk), [compaction](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-python.md#provider-compact).
- [Kotlin API](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-kotlin.md): The same bindings surface with Kotlin names, types, and signatures; includes [completion](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-kotlin.md#provider-complete), [streaming](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-kotlin.md#provider-stream), and [compaction](/docs/gdk/sdk/api-reference-kotlin.md#provider-compact).

## More documentation

- [Documentation map](/qutwo-ai-docs-map.md): Find additional guides and GDK pages by topic, with Markdown paths and section headings.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/aaif-qutwo-ai/qutwo-ai): Inspect implementations and examples. The main branch may be ahead of published releases.
